title: Smart Solar Backpack for Remote Workers
tagline: A weatherproof backpack that charges your laptop from the sun — anywhere you work.
description: Integrated 28W flexible solar panel, 20,000mAh battery and a padded 16" laptop sleeve for digital nomads.

story.intro: VoltPack began on a beach in Ericeira, when our co-founder's laptop died in the middle of a client call — two kilometres from the nearest outlet. We spent the next 18 months designing a backpack that turns any sunny spot into a workspace.
story.problem: More than 35 million people now work remotely while travelling. Power banks run out within hours, cafés are crowded, and most 'solar' bags on the market produce under 7W — barely enough to top up a phone.
story.solution: Our backpack integrates a high-efficiency 28W monocrystalline panel into a weatherproof shell, paired with a swappable 20,000mAh USB-C PD battery that can fully charge a MacBook Air in under three hours of direct sunlight.

features.title: 28W flexible solar panel
features.text: Monocrystalline cells with 23.5% efficiency, laminated into a scratch-resistant, IPX5-rated surface.

features.title: Swappable 100W PD battery
features.text: Airline-approved 20,000mAh pack with two USB-C ports and one USB-A, removable in two seconds.

features.title: Remote-worker layout
features.text: Suspended 16" laptop sleeve, quick-access cable channel and a hidden passport pocket.

features.title: Built to last
features.text: Recycled 900D polyester, YKK AquaGuard zips and a lifetime warranty on stitching.

title: Lingo Pod — AI Language Learning Device
tagline: A pocket-sized AI tutor that holds real conversations with you in 32 languages.
description: Offline speech recognition, adaptive lessons and a native-speaker voice coach that fits in your palm.

story.intro: Lingo Pod is a palm-sized device that listens, corrects and converses — like having a patient native speaker in your pocket. No subscriptions, no screens, and it works completely offline.
story.problem: Apps teach vocabulary, but fluency comes from speaking. Private tutors cost €30–€60 per hour, and 78% of learners say they feel too self-conscious to practise with real people early on.
story.solution: We compressed a multilingual speech model to run on a custom low-power chip. Lingo Pod adapts to your level, detects pronunciation errors at the phoneme level and plans daily 10-minute conversations around your interests.

features.title: 32 languages, fully offline
features.text: On-device models for speech recognition and synthesis — your voice never leaves the device.

features.title: Pronunciation coach
features.text: Phoneme-level feedback with gentle haptic cues when you stress the wrong syllable.

features.title: Adaptive curriculum
features.text: CEFR-aligned lessons from A1 to C1 that adjust to how you actually speak.

features.title: 14-day battery
features.text: USB-C charging and a magnetic lanyard so it goes everywhere with you.

title: Echoes of Kepler — Independent Sci-Fi Film
tagline: A practical-effects science fiction feature about the last radio operator on a dying colony.
description: Shot on 35mm with handmade miniatures, our debut feature brings back the craft of analogue sci-fi.

story.intro: Echoes of Kepler follows Ada Moreau, the final radio operator on a colony world whose sun is fading. When she receives a message from Earth that should be impossible, she must decide who to save.
story.problem: Mid-budget, original science fiction has nearly disappeared. Studios fund franchises; streamers fund content. Original voices with ambitious visions rarely get a chance.
story.solution: With the support of backers, we'll shoot a 95-minute feature on 35mm film, using miniatures, matte paintings and in-camera effects crafted by a team of 40 Irish artists.

features.title: Shot on 35mm
features.text: Kodak Vision3 stock, anamorphic lenses and a real grain you can feel.

features.title: Practical effects
features.text: Over 30 handmade miniatures, including a 4-metre colony relay tower.

features.title: Original score
features.text: Composed for analogue synthesisers and a 22-piece string ensemble.

features.title: Festival-ready
features.text: Targeting a premiere at a major genre festival in autumn 2027.

title: Verdant — Smart Indoor Garden
tagline: Grow fresh herbs and salad all year with an app-controlled garden that waters itself.
description: Full-spectrum LEDs, self-watering reservoir and sensor-driven care for 12 plants on your kitchen counter.

story.intro: Verdant is a beautifully designed indoor garden that takes care of itself. Drop in a seed pod, fill the reservoir once a month and harvest basil, cherry tomatoes and lettuce from your countertop.
story.problem: Supermarket herbs wilt within days and travel thousands of kilometres. Most people who try growing indoors give up within a month because light, water and nutrients are hard to balance.
story.solution: Verdant uses soil-moisture, light and temperature sensors to automatically tune its 40W full-spectrum LEDs and watering schedule. The companion app tells you exactly when to harvest.

features.title: 12 plant pods
features.text: Biodegradable pods with pre-mixed nutrients and non-GMO seeds.

features.title: Self-watering
features.text: A 4-litre reservoir lasts up to four weeks.

features.title: Adaptive light
features.text: Full-spectrum LEDs adjust to plant growth stage and daylight cycles.

features.title: Designed to be seen
features.text: Oak and powder-coated steel finish that looks good in any kitchen.

title: The Open Shelf Community Library
tagline: Turning an empty post office into a free library, maker space and homework café.
description: Help our neighbourhood reopen a historic building as a free space for reading, learning and gathering.

story.intro: The old Chapel Street post office has stood empty for six years. Our volunteer group has secured a 10-year peppercorn lease — now we need to turn it into a warm, welcoming library for everyone.
story.problem: Our neighbourhood lost its last public library in 2019. Children have nowhere quiet to do homework, and older residents have lost a vital place to meet.
story.solution: Funding will pay for accessibility works, shelving, 4,000 new books, 12 public computers and a small maker space with a 3D printer and sewing machines.

features.title: Free for everyone
features.text: No membership fees, ever. Open six days a week.

features.title: Homework café
features.text: Volunteer tutors every weekday from 3pm to 6pm.

features.title: Maker space
features.text: Tools, workshops and repair cafés every Saturday.

features.title: Fully accessible
features.text: Step-free entrance, accessible toilets and a hearing loop.

title: Terra — The Eco-Friendly Water Bottle
tagline: A plant-based, self-cleaning bottle that removes 99.9% of bacteria with UV-C light.
description: Made from sugarcane bioplastic and recycled steel, Terra keeps water cold for 24 hours and clean forever.

story.intro: Terra is the last water bottle you'll need to buy. It's made from plants and recycled steel, and its cap sterilises your water at the touch of a button.
story.problem: One million plastic bottles are bought every minute. Reusable bottles help, but many are hard to clean and quickly develop odours and bacteria.
story.solution: A mercury-free UV-C LED in Terra's cap purifies water and the bottle interior in 60 seconds, and switches on automatically every four hours.

features.title: UV-C self-cleaning
features.text: Eliminates 99.9% of bacteria and viruses, tested by an independent lab.

features.title: Plant-based materials
features.text: Sugarcane bioplastic cap and 80% recycled stainless steel body.

features.title: 24h cold, 12h hot
features.text: Double-wall vacuum insulation.

features.title: Carbon neutral shipping
features.text: Every bottle is shipped in plastic-free packaging.

title: Wanderlight — Indie Adventure Game
tagline: A hand-painted adventure about a lantern keeper exploring a world that forgets itself.
description: Explore 7 painterly islands, solve light-based puzzles and rebuild a world's lost memories. PC, Switch & PS5.

story.intro: Wanderlight is a cosy, contemplative adventure where light is your only tool. As the last lantern keeper, you'll restore memories to a world that is slowly forgetting itself.
story.problem: Small studios with distinctive art styles struggle to secure publisher deals without giving up creative control and the rights to their own worlds.
story.solution: Crowdfunding lets our five-person team stay independent, ship on three platforms and build the game together with our community through monthly playable builds.

features.title: Hand-painted world
features.text: Every frame painted in watercolour and gouache, then brought to life in Unity.

features.title: Light-based puzzles
features.text: Bend, split and colour light to reveal hidden paths.

features.title: Original soundtrack
features.text: 40 tracks by award-winning composer Léa Fontaine.

features.title: No combat, no stress
features.text: A gentle, 12-hour story for players of all ages.

title: Mobile Health Clinic for Rural Kenya
tagline: A fully equipped clinic-on-wheels bringing primary care to 14 villages.
description: Fund a converted 4x4 ambulance, medical supplies and two years of nurse salaries.

story.intro: Afya Move is a nurse-led organisation that has provided free health screenings across Nakuru County since 2019. This campaign will put our first permanent mobile clinic on the road.
story.problem: Families in the villages we serve walk an average of 19 km to reach the nearest health facility. Treatable conditions go undiagnosed and maternal care is often missed entirely.
story.solution: A converted 4x4 vehicle with an exam room, cold-chain vaccine storage, solar power and a satellite link for telemedicine consultations with doctors in Nairobi.

features.title: 14 villages, weekly
features.text: A fixed weekly schedule so families know when care is coming.

features.title: Maternal & child care
features.text: Antenatal check-ups, vaccinations and nutrition screening.

features.title: Telemedicine
features.text: Remote specialist consultations via satellite internet.

features.title: Transparent reporting
features.text: Quarterly impact reports shared with every backer.

title: Golden Hour — Debut Album Production
tagline: Recording our first full-length album live to tape with a 12-piece band.
description: Help Marisol & The Tides record, mix and press 11 songs on vinyl at a historic studio in Barcelona.

story.intro: After six years of playing bars, festivals and street corners across Spain, Marisol & The Tides are ready to record the album we've been dreaming about — live, warm and on analogue tape.
story.problem: Recording live with a full band in a quality room is expensive, and streaming royalties won't cover the cost of studio time, engineers and vinyl pressing.
story.solution: Ten days at Estudio Montjuïc with a 12-piece band, mixed by Grammy-nominated engineer Pau Ferrer and pressed on 180g vinyl.

features.title: 11 original songs
features.text: Soul, cumbia and Mediterranean folk recorded live.

features.title: Analogue to the core
features.text: 2-inch tape, vintage microphones and no click tracks.

features.title: 180g vinyl
features.text: Gatefold sleeve with artwork by illustrator Nuria Vidal.

features.title: Release tour
features.text: Twelve shows across Spain and Portugal in spring 2027.

title: Blue Tide Ocean Cleanup Initiative
tagline: Solar-powered river barriers that stop plastic before it reaches the sea.
description: Deploy 5 autonomous interceptors at river mouths in the Mediterranean, removing 300 tonnes of plastic a year.

story.intro: 80% of ocean plastic enters the sea through rivers. Blue Tide builds floating, solar-powered barriers that catch it before it gets there.
story.problem: The Mediterranean holds some of the highest concentrations of microplastics in the world, and cleanup at sea is slow, expensive and fuel-intensive.
story.solution: Our interceptors are anchored at river mouths, guiding floating debris onto a conveyor that sorts it for recycling. Each unit is monitored in real time and runs entirely on solar power.

features.title: 5 interceptors
features.text: Deployed across France, Italy and Spain by summer 2027.

features.title: 300 tonnes per year
features.text: Independently verified collection data, published live.

features.title: Wildlife safe
features.text: Designed with marine biologists to let fish pass freely.

features.title: Circular
features.text: Collected plastic is sorted and recycled into park benches.

title: Kiln & Clay — A Community Ceramics Studio
tagline: An open-access pottery studio with wood-fired kiln for artists and beginners.
description: Build a shared studio with 8 wheels, a wood-fired anagama kiln and subsidised classes.

story.intro: Kiln & Clay will be Porto's first open-access ceramics studio — a place where professional artists and complete beginners share wheels, glazes and a hand-built wood-fired kiln.
story.problem: Studio space and kiln access are out of reach for most emerging ceramicists, and beginner classes in the city have six-month waiting lists.
story.solution: A 180m² former textile workshop, fitted with eight wheels, two electric kilns and a 3-chamber anagama kiln built by the community.

features.title: Open access
features.text: Affordable monthly memberships with 24/7 studio access.

features.title: Wood-fired kiln
features.text: Community firings four times a year.

features.title: Subsidised classes
features.text: 30% of class places reserved for low-income residents.

features.title: Gallery wall
features.text: Monthly exhibitions of member work.

title: Harvest — Farm-to-Table Food Truck
tagline: Seasonal street food sourced from 12 local farms within 50 km.
description: Help us buy and fit out an electric food truck serving zero-waste, seasonal lunches.

story.intro: Harvest is a chef-run food truck serving seasonal lunches from produce grown within 50 km of the city — in compostable packaging, from an all-electric kitchen.
story.problem: Most street food relies on cheap imported ingredients and single-use plastic, while local farms struggle to find reliable buyers for imperfect produce.
story.solution: We buy 'ugly' produce directly from 12 partner farms, design our weekly menu around what's in season, and run on solar-charged batteries.

features.title: 12 partner farms
features.text: Fair prices paid within 7 days of delivery.

features.title: All-electric kitchen
features.text: Induction cooking and solar-charged batteries.

features.title: Zero-waste packaging
features.text: Home-compostable or returnable containers only.

features.title: Pay-it-forward lunches
features.text: One free meal donated for every ten sold.

title: CodeCamp for Rural Teens
tagline: Free summer coding bootcamps for 200 teenagers in rural Ireland.
description: Laptops, mentors and a 6-week curriculum that takes students from zero to their first published app.

story.intro: CodeCamp runs free six-week coding bootcamps for teenagers in rural towns, taught by volunteer engineers from Ireland's tech industry.
story.problem: Only 1 in 5 secondary schools in rural Ireland offers computer science, and the nearest paid coding courses are often hours away.
story.solution: Pop-up bootcamps in five towns, with refurbished laptops students keep afterwards, mentors on site and a demo day where each student publishes their own app.

features.title: 200 students
features.text: Across five towns in Galway, Mayo, Clare, Sligo and Donegal.

features.title: Keep the laptop
features.text: Every graduate keeps a refurbished laptop.

features.title: Real mentors
features.text: 60 volunteer engineers, designers and product managers.

features.title: Demo day
features.text: Students present their apps to families and local businesses.

title: Pennywise — Budgeting App for Students
tagline: A friendly money app that helps students stretch every euro without spreadsheets.
description: Equity crowdfunding round for our student-first budgeting app with 40,000 waitlist sign-ups.

story.intro: Pennywise is a budgeting app designed with students, for students. It turns irregular income, loans and shared rent into a simple weekly 'safe to spend' number.
story.problem: 62% of European students run out of money before the end of the month. Traditional budgeting apps assume a monthly salary — students don't have one.
story.solution: Pennywise connects to student bank accounts, forecasts cash flow around loan payments and part-time shifts, and splits shared bills automatically with flatmates.

features.title: Safe-to-spend
features.text: One number that tells you what you can spend this week.

features.title: Split bills
features.text: Automatic rent and utilities splitting with flatmates.

features.title: Student deals
features.text: Curated discounts that match your spending habits.

features.title: Bank-grade security
features.text: PSD2-licensed open banking, read-only access.

title: Help the Moreno Family Rebuild After the Floods
tagline: Our home and bakery were destroyed in the Valencia floods. Help us start again.
description: Funds will repair the family home, replace bakery ovens and cover three months of living costs.

story.intro: For 31 years, the Moreno family has baked bread for the town of Paiporta. In a single night, the floodwater rose to 1.8 metres and took their home, their bakery and their savings.
story.problem: Insurance will cover only a fraction of the damage, and the bakery — the family's only income — cannot reopen without new ovens and refrigeration.
story.solution: Every euro goes directly to the family, managed by their daughter Elena, with receipts for repairs and equipment shared in campaign updates.

features.title: Home repairs
features.text: Electrical rewiring, flooring and damp treatment.

features.title: Bakery equipment
features.text: Two deck ovens, a dough mixer and refrigeration.

features.title: Living costs
features.text: Three months of rent and essentials while the bakery reopens.

features.title: Full transparency
features.text: Receipts posted for every purchase.
